# Repo-owned small_vector snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [gharveymn/small_vector](https://github.com/gharveymn/small_vector) at commit `e8e63fe12ef578528ca5e954bc91321967e76393`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 175 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original MIT `LICENSE` and benchmark `source/bench/LICENSE` are retained. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt`; other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
